era: Northern Netherlands (Drenthe), Neolithic, c. 3400 BCE, Funnelbeaker farmers.

sheets.subject: Northern Netherlands (Drenthe), Neolithic, c. 3400 BCE, Funnelbeaker farmers. (1) a long hunebed (megalithic dolmen): two rows of large rounded glacial granite boulders carrying five huge rough capstones, low entrance on the long side; (2) a short hunebed with two capstones, partly covered by a low grassy earth mound.
sheets.ink_extra: Economical line, lighter than the anchor: fewer, longer strokes. The lit side of every object stays open white paper with no hatching at all; hatching only on the shadow side and in the darkest crevices. Leaves and grass are suggested by a few contour shapes, not drawn one by one.
